# Progress
Atlas Progress v1 - a horizontal bar showing how far a task has got. 1 property: State determinate | indeterminate (2 total). Determinate fills value / max of the track; indeterminate slides a segment along it when the duration is unknown. Track is background-muted, fill is primary, height 4 (spacing/1), radius/full. value, max, label, value text and helper text are props or composed slots, not variants. A progress bar has no fixed width: it fills its container.

When to use: a task with a known percentage or step count (upload, export, form steps), or a running task of unknown length (indeterminate).
When not to use: for a wait with no layout at all (use Spinner), for content that is still loading into a known layout (use Skeleton), or for choosing a value (use Slider).

Motion: fill width animates with duration/base and easing/standard. Indeterminate slides over duration/pulse (2000ms) with easing/linear, looping. Under prefers-reduced-motion the slide stops.

Accessibility: role=progressbar with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow (omitted when indeterminate). Name via aria-label or aria-labelledby; optional aria-valuetext. No hover, focus, active or disabled state.
